newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-UNICEF NAMES WEAH ITS ENVOY FOR SPORT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNICEF NAMES WEAH ITS ENVOY FOR SPORT.

text.p: The United Nations Children's Fund UNICEF named Liberia's George Weah its ambassador for sport on Monday and said he would play a special role in raising awareness about AIDS and child victims of war.
The AC Milan striker was appointed to the position at a ceremony in Milan.

"Having lived with the hostilities in his native Liberia, Weah commands the understanding necessary to devote special attention to the particular needs of children in the midst of conflict," UNICEF regional director Andre Roberfroid said in a statement.
It said Weah would also work closely with the UNAIDS agency to "mobilise the global football community to play a larger role in HIV/AIDS prevention and care".
UNICEF has a host of celebrity "special representatives" who donate their services in support of the agency's work.
Among them are actors Roger Moore, Peter Ustinov and Liv Ullmann and singers Harry Belafonte, Julio Iglesias and Youssou N'Dour.
